Release notes

Versions and release notes

The website and the open Framework have independent versions. This edition identifies its exact accepted knowledge source.

Website

v1.2.0-rc.1

Release candidate

Candidate for review. The proposed website experience is separate from the accepted Framework knowledge release shown below.

Included knowledge

Framework v1.1.0

Release notes ↗

Exact accepted knowledge revision: 05a3572

Changes proposed for website 1.2.0

  • Eight navigation areas, business-first vocabulary and in-context concept panels with history.
  • Interactive anatomy, layers × stages, RACI, access simulator and first-case preparation.
  • Role and organisation journeys; illustrative company, municipality and professional council examples.
  • Implementation chooser, tool filters, downloadable resources and a local canvas generator.
  • Four languages, accessible dialogs, quick search, light/dark theme and accepted Markdown reader with provenance.

Version 1 baseline

On 21 October 2026, the existing website and accepted knowledge were recorded as v1.0.0 in their own repositories. The tagged files retain their historical 0.1 labels. This designation preserves history; it does not certify the model or announce a new product.
